name: APRICITY
source:
[i]"It's never too late for anything. Do you really wish to remain here, forever?"[/i]

death is never the end. the BEYOND awaits you. but where...?

with only etched letters in a headstone as her lead, saffron finds herself in a desolate, snowy cemetery - with an enigmatic statue of an angel at its center. unsure of what to do, she reaches out... and the statue's... animated?

[From [url=https://ephemeri.itch.io/apricity]Itch.io[/url]]
